fix_code:
def main():
  N, M = map(int, input().split())
  A = list(map(int, input().split()))
  X = [list(map(int, input().split())) for _ in range(N)]
  
  ans = "Yes"
  
  for i in range(M):
    total = 0
    for j in range(N):
      total += X[j][i]
    if total < A[i]:
      ans = "No"
      print(ans)
      return
  
  print(ans)
  return
